call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management said it cannot comment on future margins.
Structural margins improved upwards of 300 bps in FY26, driven by premium innovation and cost savings.
Crude and resins are up about 50% each, with availability significantly challenged due to the West Asia conflict.
Productivity savings of ₹38 Cr were delivered in FY26 via targeted programs.
Female grooming (Venus) contributes double digit to Grooming and is growing upwards of 20%.
Oral-B Power Oral Care grew at almost 1.5 times this year; manual oral care grows high single-digits.
Bhiwadi plant concerns were fully resolved in a few days with zero supply-related challenges.
Export revenue was hit by affiliate calls, including the Bangladesh distribution agreement closure; excluding it, growth doubles.

timeline.summary: On 16 June 2026, Gillette India's management call reported FY26 sales of ₹3,100 Cr (up 8%) and PAT of about ₹650 Cr (up 23%), with structural margins up over 300 bps.

watchlist.response: Management attributed part of it to one-time export impacts from affiliate decisions, including the Bangladesh distribution agreement closure, and said growth doubles excluding that; domestic sales grow quarter on quarter.
watchlist.text: Growth appears muted and volatile, with a meaningful slowdown in FY26 revenue growth.

watchlist.response: Management cited upwards of 300 bps structural margin improvement from premium innovation and productivity, but said it cannot comment on the future.
